title: Thurston norm, polytopes and splitting complexity
summary: Let $G$ be a finitely generated torsion-free group satisfying the Strong Atiyah Conjecture. Assuming that $b_1^{(2)}(G)=0$, we associate to each surjective integral character $φ$ the quantity $b_1^{(2)}(\ker φ)$. We prove that the resulting function extends to a seminorm on $H^1(G;\mathbb{R})$ and is the thickness function of a polytope in $H_1(G;\mathbb{R})$. More generally, assuming that $G$ is of type $\mathrm{FP}_k(\mathbb{Q})$ and has $b_k^{(2)}(G)=0$, we prove that the function assigning $b_k^{(2)}(\ker φ)$ to each surjective integral character $φ$ is likewise the thickness function of…
